title.zh: 修复 Safari 语言弹窗并精简旗舰版导师界面
title.en: Fix Safari language dismissal and streamline the Max tutor

purpose.zh: 消除 Safari 语言弹窗关闭后的视觉残影，让导师形象与语音按钮在窄屏上更易使用。
purpose.en: Remove the stale Safari language popover and make tutor portraits and voice controls easier to use on narrow screens.

zh: 沿用 Guandan 已验证的扁平语言选项与普通按钮结构，保留简体和繁体中文及原有语言顺序。
删除覆盖原生 details 关闭状态的重复 display:none 规则，保留点击外部和 Escape 关闭行为。
导师形象横排可滚动，照片上也可用左右箭头切换，通话中箭头置灰；照片左上角的对话按钮可展开或收起可滚动的导师文字；移除多余的 AI 圆形装饰；音色选择放在照片上，通话中置灰，实时语音按钮紧接照片下方。
en: Reuse Guandan's verified flat language options and plain buttons while preserving Simplified and Traditional Chinese and the existing language order.
Remove the redundant display:none rule overriding the native details close state while retaining outside-click and Escape dismissal.

Let portrait choices scroll horizontally or switch with photo arrows that gray out during calls; add an initially-off chat toggle for scrollable tutor text, remove the extra AI circle, and place voice selection on the photo with a disabled gray state during calls and live-voice controls immediately below it.

zh: 共享页头的语言切换弹窗及旗舰版 AI 导师页面；不改学习语言、账户、订阅或支付。
en: Shared-header language switcher and Max AI tutor page; no changes to learning languages, accounts, subscriptions, or payments.

zh: 用 Guandan 的 details、summary、扁平选项及 aria-pressed 结构替换旧的 role=menu/menuitemradio 嵌套结构。
清理旧弹窗 CSS，尤其是造成 Safari 视觉残影的 details:not([open]) 额外隐藏规则；保持 SmartLingo 的配色及站点语言路径。
导师形象选择改成有边界的横向滚动，原面板不因新增照片悬浮箭头而改变；箭头共用现有保存逻辑；复用现有实时字幕并由照片上的对话按钮展开；音色下拉移到照片右上角，语音按钮移到照片下方，不改变语音通话逻辑。
en: Replace the old role=menu/menuitemradio nesting with Guandan's details, summary, flat options, and aria-pressed structure.
Remove obsolete popover CSS, especially the extra details:not([open]) hiding rule that left a stale Safari visual layer; preserve SmartLingo colors and locale routing.

Keep the existing horizontally scrollable portrait chooser unchanged while adding floating photo arrows using the same preference-saving logic; toggle the existing transcript from the photo, overlay the voice selector on the photo, and move the existing voice-call controls without rewriting them.

zh: 站点策略门禁、TypeScript、零警告 lint、测试、构建与中英文 WebKit 响应式检查。
发布后在 Safari 和 Chrome 实测弹层打开、外部点击关闭、语言切换及导师页布局，并核对精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Site policy gates, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, tests, build, and Chinese/English responsive WebKit checks.
After deployment, test opening, outside dismissal, language switching, and the tutor layout in Safari and Chrome, then verify the exact Project release record.

zh: 无付款、账户或实时导师行为变更。
en: No payment, account, or live-tutor behavior changes.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 的十三个界面语言及路径、本地学习语言选择与现有品牌色。
en: Preserve SmartLingo's thirteen interface locales, routes, independent learning-language selection, and brand colors.

rollback.zh: 回退到上一部署提交；数据库无变更。
rollback.en: Deploy the prior commit; no database change is involved.
